is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae Kisumu (KIS) and Anopheles coluzzii VK5 (VK5) colonies (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping of the KDR-W (L1014F) mutation in the VK5 colony (page 4, 8).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study reports the percentage of individuals exhibiting pyrethroid-resistant phenotypes (homozygous or heterozygous for the KDR-W allele) for the VK5 colony (page 8).

african_field_population.evidence: The VK5 colony was established from 150 blood-fed females collected from the village of VK5 in the Kou Valley, Burkina Faso (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating long-acting injectable ivermectin formulations in a cattle-mosquito model.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the collection site as the village of VK5 in the Kou Valley, Burkina Faso (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The VK5 colony was established in November 2020 and experiments began in January 2021 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new experimental setup using specific long-acting injectable formulations (LAIFs) developed for this study.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data (KDR-W status) is reported in the main text (page 8) and referenced as being detailed in Additional file 1: Table S6.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the mosquitocidal efficacy of three long-acting injectable ivermectin formulations (LAIFs) in cattle using a cattle-mosquito model. The study used two mosquito colonies: the susceptible Anopheles gambiae Kisumu (KIS) and the resistant Anopheles coluzzii VK5. The VK5 colony was collected from the Kou Valley, Burkina Faso, and was genotyped for the KDR-W (L1014F) mutation.
